summary: Iteration 35 - Massive Update Testing Complete. All 19 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified all key features including public bookings page rewrite, kiosk enhancements, and portal rename.
seed_data_creation: Test events created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 35 massive update features all verified: (1) Public bookings page complete rewrite - hero section with 58:12 mission info, country selector with auto-detect, event search bar, events grouped by type in columns, free vs paid distinction with badges. (2) Payment flow - paid events show payment method selector (Card/MTN/Airtel/Venmo/Cash), cash cutoff rules working (no cash within 3 days), terms agreement checkbox. (3) Mark-as-paid endpoint - PUT /api/public/bookings/{id}/mark-paid requires staff role, tested and working. (4) Pending payments - GET /api/public/bookings/pending-payments lists unpaid bookings, requires staff auth. (5) Policies endpoint - GET /api/public/policies returns 6 policies (privacy, terms, refund, employee onboarding, data retention, cookie) with US/EU/Uganda/Kenya/Thailand/Haiti/Mexico compliance. (6) Report generation fix - db.checkins collection name fixed (not db.check_ins). (7) New user signup - role defaults to 'Member' with status 'pending'. (8) Kiosk enhancements - company logo (58:12 Global), lock mode button, quick signup dialog, checkout button, QR scan handler with success/fail sounds. (9) Public events - country filter working, 1-year limit enforced, sorted by upcoming date. (10) Footer - staff login link, 5812-Global.org link, policy links all present. (11) Portal renamed to 'User Portal' - visible in sidebar.

public_bookings_page.details: Complete rewrite verified - hero section with 58:12 mission info, country selector (All Locations default), event search bar (36 events found), events grouped by type (Services with 12 events), free vs paid badges, registration dialog with name/email/phone/tickets fields

payment_flow.details: Payment methods (card, mobile_money_mtn, mobile_money_airtel, venmo, cash) working. Cash cutoff rules enforced - cash rejected within 3 days of event. Terms agreement checkbox present for paid events.

mark_as_paid_endpoint.details: PUT /api/public/bookings/{id}/mark-paid requires staff auth (401 without auth), works with staff token, accepts transaction_ref and notes

pending_payments_endpoint.details: GET /api/public/bookings/pending-payments requires staff auth, returns list of pending bookings

policies_endpoint.details: GET /api/public/policies returns 6 policies: privacy_policy, terms_of_service, refund_policy, employee_onboarding, data_retention, cookie_policy. Content mentions GDPR, Uganda, and other jurisdictions.

report_generation_fix.details: Attendance report generation uses db.checkins (not db.check_ins). Report created and generated successfully.

new_user_signup.details: New registration defaults to role='Member' and status='pending'

kiosk_enhancements.details: Company logo (58:12 Global) visible, Lock mode button present, Quick Signup button and dialog working, Checkout button visible, ID/QR Check-In button present

public_events_filtering.details: Country filter parameter works, 1-year limit enforced on event dates, events sorted by upcoming date
